text:
emily: Heads-up: planning a schema deploy tonight 23:00 UTC for the tenant_id compatibility shim. No physical column type change in this wave — just a view + shim to let old clients keep working. Need a short deploy window and pin for mobile/web releases.
raj: Sounds good. We'll limit to <= 10k tenants per batch and keep locks minimal. Can we avoid any long-running backfills?
oliver: Agreed. Plan: create a view and a small trigger to route writes to the new bigint column only when feature flag is on. No mass row-copy.
maria: Deploy bot scheduled when you confirm. I'll set staging canary at 22:30 and prod at 23:00 if canary looks good.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @emily for "compat-shim-tenantid" at 2024-11-12T23:00Z. Approvers required: @raj. Canary: staging @ 22:30.
raj: Approved :thumbsup:. Also request we set `lock_timeout` to a safe value in the migration session. Keep retries disabled.
emily: Good call. Ops snippet I'll use in the migration job: ```sql
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
BEGIN;
-- create compatibility view that selects from new column if present
CREATE VIEW tenant_compat AS
SELECT id, COALESCE(tenant_bigint, CAST(tenant_varchar AS bigint)) AS tenant_id, *
FROM tenants;
COMMIT;
```
oliver: Nice. For writes we add runtime shim in service: if feature flag off, write to varchar column; if on, write to bigint and mirror to varchar for compatibility. That avoids long copy.
emily: Rollback plan: 1) Flip feature flag off 2) Pin frontend/backend to v1.24.3 (current pinned stable) 3) If needed, restore snapshot taken at 22:50 (we'll take one right before prod). 4) Remove view only after confirming zero reads to new field.
sre-oncall: I'll watch error rates and tail slow queries post-deploy. If p50 > 150ms or p95 spikes, we'll abort and flip flag.
maria: Release notes checklist: include migration description, affected endpoints, required app pin version, and ops contact @sre-oncall. I'll add it to the changelog PR.
emily: One more: inform support and CS — small tenants might see transient 409s while we settle routing. I'll DM @support lead.
raj: Ok proceed. Staging canary at 22:30, prod at 23:00. Monitoring alerts: set an ephemeral alert for 30m post-deploy to catch regressions.
maria: Deploybot will post status updates to this thread. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging at 2024-11-12T22:31Z. No errors in initial smoke tests.
deploy-bot: Prod deploy started at 2024-11-12T23:00Z. Applying schema: creating view and trigger.
maria: Smoke checks pass. No lock waiters observed in the first 2 minutes.
sre-oncall: Observability: traces show an extra 3-5ms p95 on tenant lookup — acceptable. No action.
emily: Flipping feature flag now for batch 1 (10 tenants).
maria: Batch 1 success. No errors. Taking pre-rollout snapshot for safety.
emily: Continuing batches every 5m.
raj: If any batch shows >0.5% errors, stop and roll back.
emily: All batches complete at 23:25. Metrics look steady. Updating release notes and unpin instructions.
maria: Final: rollout complete. I'll close the deploy and update the changelog. Thanks everyone. :tada:
